subject: A session cannot report its own state in one shape
recordedOccasion: after the owner asked why every session's state report looks different and proposed a table.
severity: Q1 is load-bearing -- without a shape, a printed report and a chat answer cannot be checked against each other.
feltAt: every session hand-off in this tree
scope: session management. This is a commission: its deliverable is a blueprint under docs/architecture/, not a script.

members.statement: What is the shape of a session state report -- what does a dossier row carry, what does a member row carry, and what makes a member recently changed
Is the printed report and the chat-response schema one artifact or two, and if one, what makes a chat answer checkable against it
Does a dossier's member table take the vocabulary of its genus -- Questions, Tasks -- or one word for all four, given the prefix already carries the genus
members.sectionHeading: Q3 -- a commission's members are questions, and the checkers said Findings

edges.why: a state report is another reader of the projection map F14 ruled on; it must read the data and not the projections
F31 fixed the checkers that could not see Q members; Q3 is the vocabulary half and is not decided while this bundle is unclaimed

indexNotes: The first commission in the tree. Recorded unclaimed and deliberately not assigned.
